'''Bilbringi V''' was one of the drydocks of the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]. It was a [[Repair Yard]] owned and operated by [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Azzameen family]]'s interests were seized in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and their business rivals, [[Viraxo Industries]], Bilbringi V remained as possibly the family's only remaining station from which to operate its vast fleet of transports.

==Description==
The station was a [[Repair Yard]], a product of the [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]] that took on the role of shipyard and repair yard. It had drydock facilities for at least two large starships, but could accommodate many more vessels if they were of a smaller size. It was also suited for shuttles and transports. This station was totally unarmed.

Like the similar [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Sun Station]], the facility's main function was to serve as a hub for the Azzameen family's transport fleet, as well as a center of repairs for civilian vessels.

==History==
[[File:AceBilbringi.png|thumb|left|250px|''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'' at Bilbringi V]]
Bilbringi V was one of the only [[Azzameen family|Azzameen]]-owned facilities to remain in operation after the business was [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|seized]] by the Empire. During the year [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], shortly before the discovery of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], [[Aeron Azzameen]] learnt that a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Vergesso Base|shipyard]] in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] was in desperate need of supplies, and so she commissioned a fleet of transports to steal supplies from a Viraxo facility that harbored these particular supplies. This operation would result in a significant payoff from the Rebel Alliance that would assist the financially-deprived Azzameen family. However, it was to be conducted in secret and without the knowledge of [[Antan Azzameen]], who had little desire to help the Rebels. Aeron and her brother [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] arrived at Bilbringi V on board the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', where they linked up with six [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] from [[Juno (cargo ferry group)|Juno Group]] and two [[modular conveyor]]s from [[Lara (group)|Lara Group]]. The task force then set out to raid the Viraxo facility [[VXO-33274]] where the targeted supplies were being stored.
